fact: The June 2025 INSEED report on 2023 foreign trade states that its data come from the customs information system and customs-office collection plus extra-customs sources (petroleum ministry, Kribi terminal, gum arabic observatory), and that INSEED has produced such statistics for some years.
title: Statistiques du Commerce Extérieur 2023
publisher: Institut National de la Statistique, des Etudes Economiques et Démographiques (INSEED)
